currentParagraphText: “Alright, but as I said, it isn’t simple, and there are two primary reasons. First of all, I was told to try and make the Desolate Child of Loss into an ally. You weren’t the first one who became aware of the creature. The Holy Church had sacrificed people before to know more about what they were dealing with and ultimately decided they wanted to try and use the False God if possible. But to be clear, they don’t view the Desolate Child of Loss as an actual creature but just a tool,” Jacob began. “That leads to my second reason. I’m an Augur. Even before I am a member of the Holy Church, that’s my Path. Before this Desolate Child of Loss, I had never met a creature who needed guidance more. You called him a living calamity, but he is not. He is just a creature with power he’s never learned to control and emotions he cannot comprehend. As the name implies... he is still only a child.”
